key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Immediate, within seconds to minutes of standing. LOCATION: Generalized lightheadedness, dizziness. DURATION: Brief, seconds to minutes, resolves when sitting/lying down. CHARACTER: Lightheadedness, dizziness, blurred vision, weakness. AGGRAVATING: STANDING UP from sitting or lying, prolonged standing, hot environment, dehydration. RELIEVING: Sitting or lying down immediately. TIMING: Reproducible with postural changes. SEVERITY: Variable, can lead to syncope if severe. KEY POSITIVES: Occurs with postural change, elderly patient, medications (antihypertensives, diuretics), dehydration, rapid resolution when sitting. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT constant dizziness, NOT spinning vertigo (BPPV), NOT exertional.

red_flags: Syncope or actual loss of consciousness
